note: The same three surfaces, Areas, Pulse and Stay, asked in the local language about the local capital, in nine markets. This is the follow up to the surfaces probe, and its purpose was to find out whether the pattern found in German and Spanish holds elsewhere. It does, and it overturns a conclusion reached the day before.
headline: All eleven primary markets have real demand for Areas, Pulse and Stay, including the four that the cost of living research on 23 September called thin. Those four were thin for one vertical, not for the product. The market gate has to be per surface rather than per market, and that is an architectural correction rather than an adjustment.
caution: Eight phrasings per market against one capital city. It sizes an intent and it does not enumerate a market. A phrasing in notReturned is one the provider had no row for at all.
cpcUnit: USD cents, as the API returns them

conclusions: The market gate was asking the wrong question. It asked whether a market has demand, and a market does not have demand: a market has demand for a surface. Japan and Taiwan were judged thin against a cost of living seed and both are real Areas and Stay markets. Poland and the Netherlands were judged thin the same way and both carry Pulse terms in the thousands. The gate belongs at the surface level.

Coworking is the highest value single category in the programme and it is a category inside a places family rather than a family of its own. Coworking London carries a six dollar cost per click, Berlin and Barcelona and Amsterdam three to four dollars, Warsaw one dollar twenty, Tokyo fifty cents. It is measured in eight of the nine markets probed.

Rooms and shared housing are the largest Stay intent everywhere and they are almost invisible in English. Colocation Paris 5,000, share houses Tokyo 5,400, rooms in Warsaw 1,700 at difficulty 0, rooms in London 1,700 at difficulty 1, rooms in Barcelona 1,600 at difficulty 2, rooms in Berlin 1,600, rooms in Milan 1,400 at difficulty 0. The equivalent English phrasing about a foreign city returned no row at all.

Events today is a better target than events this weekend in five of the nine markets, and the reverse in the others. Both windows are in the family and which one leads is a market by market fact rather than a global one. Tokyo events today at difficulty 1 with 2,700 searches is the single easiest large term found in the entire Atlas research.
